text:
mira: Opening a small PR to add a local repro + troubleshooting checklist for 429s/timeouts when context limits are hit. Will include a Python SDK snippet and a curl example.

sam: please include concrete retry numbers ops can use (start, max, jitter).

mira: suggested backoff: start 200ms, max 5s, exponential with jitter. Also will call out how to detect context-eviction vs rate-limit by checking headers and response body.

doc-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901 (draft). Tags: docs, err-ref, 429, timeout.

jordan: add a one-line note about Dedicated vs Hosted concurrency limits so readers don't confuse per-connection vs account windows.

mira: added a one-liner and linked to /docs/runtime/capacity. Also replaced an outdated context-trim link with /docs/runtime/context-trim-v2 and added a short migration note about switching to KV-aware trim.

len: small nit: don't recommend infinite retries in examples. Show max_attempts=3.

mira: updated python snippet to include max_attempts=3 and trimming earliest messages before retry. Also added a curl example that checks for HTTP 429 and Retry-After header.

sam: add a short bullet explaining difference between "stream interrupted" and "request timed out" in streaming examples.

mira: done 1 added two bullets and a brief code comment.

jordan: I'll do a quick copy/link sanity check after lunch. Please run the docs linter and link-checker before merging.

doc-bot: Reminder: run docs linter and link-checker prior to merge.

mira: fixed one broken anchor locally and pushed. PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901.
